issue.title: Doctor inpatient screen cannot receive its listed vitals.due event
issue.actual: doctor_inpatients lists/subscribes to vitals.due, but that event's audience is ipd.flowsheet.record. demo.doctor holds ipd.flowsheet.view and ipd.admission.view, not ipd.flowsheet.record. With two real live clients on the same new synthetic admission, nurse received vitals.due event243 while doctor did not. Both received admission.overflow_assigned241, so the Doctor's connection was active.
issue.expected: Deliver the inpatient screen's due-vitals refresh signal to authorised doctor/flowsheet viewers as promised by its bundle, or correct the screen contract and define its supported refresh mechanism. Do not grant doctors nurse recording permission or require frontend polling/guessed alerts. The server remains the source of overdue/due status.
issue.steps: Fresh scenario b6c881 patient9/admission10, own ward10/beds40–41. Open real demo.doctor and demo.nurse terminal sessions before the event. Overflow-assign/admit10 to own40. Record synthetic past observations (API observed_at), then PUT vitals-schedule interval_minutes15. Worker emits actual event243: nurse sees it, doctor does not. No clock simulation or real care. See independent real client journals.
